common_sections.title: Executive Summary
common_sections.description: High-level overview of the analysis scope, key findings, and strategic recommendations
common_sections.content_guidance: 2-3 paragraph summary covering: what was analyzed, top 3-5 key findings, and primary strategic recommendation

common_sections.title: Market Context
common_sections.description: Global and local market landscape relevant to the analysis
common_sections.content_guidance: Include relevant data points, market size figures, growth rates. Use tables for comparative data.

common_sections.title: Consumer Landscape
common_sections.description: Target audience analysis, behavior patterns, and consumer insights
common_sections.content_guidance: Define 2-4 key consumer segments. Include behavioral data and perception analysis.

common_sections.title: Competitive Landscape
common_sections.content_guidance: Identify 4-6 key competitors. Use a comparison TABLE for competitive analysis. Include positioning insights.

common_sections.title: Key Insights
common_sections.description: Synthesized insights from market, consumer, and competitive analysis
common_sections.content_guidance: 3-5 actionable insights derived from the analysis above. Each insight should connect data to strategic implication.

type_specific_sections.title: Strategic Approach
type_specific_sections.description: Recommended strategic direction and positioning options
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Present 2-3 strategic options. Recommend one with clear rationale.

type_specific_sections.title: Positioning Map
type_specific_sections.description: Visual positioning analysis showing brand placement vs competitors
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Define 2 key positioning axes. Describe where the brand and competitors sit. Identify white-space opportunities. Reference a positioning map chart.

type_specific_sections.title: Strategy Build
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Include a clear positioning statement. Build messaging hierarchy. Outline content pillars and channel recommendations.

type_specific_sections.title: Measurement & Roadmap
type_specific_sections.description: KPIs, implementation timeline, and risk assessment
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Define 5-8 measurable KPIs in a TABLE. Create a 3-phase roadmap (30/60/90 days or Q1/Q2/Q3). Include budget ranges and top risks.

type_specific_sections.title: Competitor Deep Dive
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Detailed profile per competitor in TABLE format. SWOT for top 3. Identify sustainable competitive advantages.

type_specific_sections.title: Competitive Strategy
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Map differentiation opportunities. Outline response strategies for competitive threats.

type_specific_sections.title: Action Plan & Recommendations
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Prioritized action items in TABLE. 90-day timeline. Define measurable success metrics.

type_specific_sections.title: Technical SEO Analysis
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Include technical metrics in TABLEs. Score each area. Identify critical technical issues.

type_specific_sections.title: Content & On-Page SEO
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Keyword opportunity TABLE. Content gaps vs competitors. Page-level optimization recommendations.

type_specific_sections.title: Off-Page & Authority
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Backlink metrics in TABLE. Authority comparison vs competitors. Prioritized link building tactics.

type_specific_sections.title: SEO Roadmap & KPIs
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Categorize actions by timeline. Define ranking and traffic KPIs in TABLE.

type_specific_sections.title: Platform Strategy & Content Pillars
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Rank 3-4 priority platforms with rationale. Define 4-5 content pillars with example formats. Establish brand voice guardrails.

type_specific_sections.title: Content Calendar Framework
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Define posting frequency per platform in a TABLE. Specify a content mix ratio (e.g. 40% educational / 30% promotional / 30% engagement). Flag upcoming seasonal moments to tie into.

type_specific_sections.title: Engagement & Community Growth
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Outline response-time SLAs and engagement tactics. Identify UGC/influencer collaboration opportunities. List 3-5 organic growth tactics.

type_specific_sections.title: Measurement & Optimization
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Define KPIs per platform (reach, engagement rate, follower growth, conversion) in a TABLE. Propose an A/B testing roadmap for content formats.

type_specific_sections.title: Market Readiness Assessment
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Assess regulatory/compliance requirements for the target market. Identify localization needs (language, payment methods, cultural fit). Score entry barriers (High/Med/Low) with rationale.

type_specific_sections.title: Entry Model & Go-To-Market Approach
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Compare entry modes (direct, partnership, franchise, acquisition) in a TABLE. Recommend one with rationale. Identify potential local partners/channels.

type_specific_sections.title: Localized Positioning & Pricing
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Map local competitors. Recommend price positioning relative to the local market (adjusted for local purchasing power). Flag messaging/cultural adaptations needed.

type_specific_sections.title: Entry Roadmap & Risk Plan
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: 90/180/365-day phased entry plan in a TABLE. Estimate investment ranges per phase. Identify the top 3-5 market entry risks with mitigation.

type_specific_sections.title: Content Pillars & Themes
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Define 4-5 content pillars tied to brand goals. Map upcoming seasonal/cultural moments relevant to the brand. Recommend a format mix (video/carousel/static/blog).

type_specific_sections.title: Editorial Calendar
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Produce a 30-day content grid TABLE (Date, Platform, Pillar, Format, Caption Hook). Note platform-specific adaptations. Specify publishing frequency per channel.

type_specific_sections.title: Production Workflow & Resourcing
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Outline the content pipeline from ideation to publish. Define an approval workflow with turnaround SLAs. Flag resourcing/tooling gaps.

type_specific_sections.title: Performance Tracking
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Define per-format KPIs in a TABLE. Set a cadence for reviewing top/bottom performing content. Outline how insights feed back into the next cycle.

type_specific_sections.title: Detailed Analysis
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Deep dive into the analysis topic. Use TABLEs for data comparison.

type_specific_sections.title: Strategic Recommendations
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: 3-5 prioritized recommendations. Each with rationale, effort level, and expected impact.

type_specific_sections.title: Next Steps & Measurement
type_specific_sections.content_guidance: Actionable next steps in TABLE format. Define measurable outcomes.
